tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground. Dark is the primary theme (hero, nav, client pages, footer).

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Panels and cards on surface, with a hairline border. No shadows.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Alternate section bands, form inputs, table header rows.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px borders on panels, dividers, table rules.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and primary text on surface, surface-raised and surface-alt.

tokens.name: ink-body
tokens.usage: Running text on surface, surface-raised and surface-alt.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Notes, captions and source lines on surface, surface-raised and surface-alt.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Brand cyan as a FILL: logo dot, eyebrow dot, primary button, rules, trajectory discs. Not for text on light grounds.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Cyan used as TEXT: eyebrows, stats, links, active nav. Deep teal in light theme to keep 4.5:1.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill. Never white on cyan.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard focus outline, 3px offset, on every interactive element.

tokens.name: signal-error
tokens.usage: Form errors and destructive messages only, as text or a 1px border.

tokens.name: brand-charcoal
tokens.usage: Core brand charcoal (deck background). Fixed across themes; logo ground.

tokens.name: brand-black
tokens.usage: Deck card black. Fixed across themes.

tokens.name: brand-cyan
tokens.usage: The logo dot cyan, sampled from the wordmark. Fixed across themes.

tokens.name: brand-white
tokens.usage: Wordmark white. Fixed across themes.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Home hero headline only. Once per page at most.

styles.name: heading-1
styles.sample: One client. Three to five roles. Ninety days.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Big numbers in accent-text, always with a label and a source.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Sling recruits, trains and runs skilled teams in South Africa.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: One monthly fee per team member. Sling owns recruitment, employment, workspace and quality.
styles.usage: Running text, kept to the measure token.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside running text, button labels.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: UK overlap; US coverage by design.
styles.usage: Card body, form help text, stat labels.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase label above a headline, in accent-text with the dot marker. One per section.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Source: Statistics South Africa, QLFS Q2 2026
styles.usage: Source lines and footnotes in ink-muted.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Eyebrow dot gap, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Label to field, stat value to label.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Minimum page side gutter on phones; button horizontal padding is 1.5x.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Grid gutter; card padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; gap between groups inside a section.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Headline block to content.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Hero top and bottom padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, inputs, photo frames.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Larger panels and modals.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons and tags: the round form echoes the dot.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Max content width; 12-column grid inside.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max width of running text.
